messages.body: Re-reviewed S2 at head a960241d781231af4d1bf30ffba27b9887e363d1 with CLI probes: fenced marker example untouched, duplicate/stray markers exit 2 with nothing written and --check never 0, --stdout prints the full document, and --check with --stdout exits 2. AC-1/4/5/6 all hold with a guarding test named for each claim, the 69 unit tests pass, and the CRLF, empty-file, unclosed-marker and H1-only edge probes show no regression. One new LOW remains: markers inside inline code spans are still matched (it only silently rewrites prose when no real pair exists), and I left it for you to defer or fix.
